scope: Analytical capacity model with the integrated_v1 component instruments. Concurrency widths, per-lane and per-port tile charges, and the source-to-data transfer are declared assumptions, not compiled schedules. Richardson residuals are the measured finite-patch envelope of |(4E(2r)-E(r))/3| r^4 at r >= 8 tau. The time-growing family uses the running maximum of all measured patches through each time; no patch larger than 4x4 is measured. Interacting bulk convergence is not established. v2 uses the Stim-calibrated surface-code law for both encoded arms; its fit is memory-only at d=3-9 and is extrapolated to the distances used here.
